chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said: “When the two circumcised parts meet, then flogging becomes obligatory.”

key_terms.الْجَلْدُ: flogging, the prescribed corporal punishment in this context
key_terms.الْخِتَانَانِ: the two circumcised parts, referring to the sexual organs of the man and woman

ai.seo_question: When does the hadd punishment of flogging become obligatory in zina according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the establishment of the hadd punishment for zina. It indicates that once sexual intercourse is realized by the meeting of the circumcised parts, the legal penalty of flogging becomes obligatory.
